narration: For {identical_months} months the two lives ran exactly the same. In month {fork_month}, you chose {real_choice}, and the ghost took {ghost_choice}. That same month, {widest_gap_month}, the money was as far apart as it would ever be, and the ghost had {widest_gap}. When the layoff came in month {layoff_month}, the ghost had {layoff_net_worth_gap}. By month {end_month}, the ghost had {net_worth_gap}. Its cushion for a stretch with no salary sat {safety_gap}.
